$comment: Build/test-time policy inventory + enforcement matrix for plugin-api-policy-enforcement-closure. Derived from the canonical registry and the actual host public surface; never imported as mutable runtime state. Each inventory row carries the full 16-field set (freeze decision 9); non-applicable fields are explicit null. Validated by scripts/policy-inventory-validate.mjs.

inventory.componentOwner: official llm request owner and adapter preparation
inventory.reducer/conflictRule: registration order pipeline; same owner replaces its prior generation
inventory.defaultDecision: no registered transform: request passes through unchanged
inventory.automaticDecisionPoint: llm/request-transform (request preparation before adapter stream begins)
inventory.observableEvidence: existing llm request transform tests; registry/surface consistency
inventory.failureAndCancellation: callback failure contained; abort propagates; generation-bound dispose

inventory.decisionVocabulary: admission allow | deny for an llm request
inventory.reducer/conflictRule: admission composition; deny wins; deterministic same-precedence order
inventory.automaticDecisionPoint: llm/admission (RPC admission gateway before request dispatch)
inventory.failureAndCancellation: callback failure contained; fail-safe official default; abort propagated

inventory.decisionVocabulary: route selection decision for an llm call
inventory.reducer/conflictRule: route policy reducer; deterministic same-precedence order
inventory.automaticDecisionPoint: route (route decision owner before route commit)
inventory.observableEvidence: existing exec-route and llm routing tests; registry/surface consistency
inventory.failureAndCancellation: callback failure contained; official default; no second decision on late completion

inventory.componentOwner: official llm routing health transition owner
inventory.reducer/conflictRule: circuit policy reducer; latest generation replaces previous; dispose is identity-bound
inventory.automaticDecisionPoint: circuit (health transition owner on status change)
inventory.observableEvidence: existing llm routing health tests; registry/surface consistency
inventory.failureAndCancellation: callback failure contained; official default transition; stale generation cannot flip a newer state

inventory.decisionVocabulary: audience / visibility decision for an execution record
inventory.reducer/conflictRule: visibility policy reducer; deterministic same-precedence order
inventory.failureAndCancellation: callback failure contained; official default audience; projection stays read-only

inventory.componentOwner: agent-loop request-error owner; facade task/transaction terminal owners
inventory.decisionVocabulary: recovery action (retry | fallback | abort | stop | no-op)
inventory.reducer/conflictRule: recovery action validation and retry bounds; single consumption per operation window
inventory.defaultDecision: official retry waterfall / documented fail-safe default
inventory.automaticDecisionPoint: recovery/model, recovery/tool, recovery/task, recovery/transaction (single-consumption authority in Wave 4)
inventory.protectedAction: next attempt, fallback or terminal outcome commit after a failure
inventory.cooperativeInterface: executions.recovery.evaluate (operation; caller honors the returned action)
inventory.observableEvidence: existing recovery-policy tests; Wave 4 recovery-consumption tests
inventory.failureAndCancellation: callback failure contained; fail-safe recovery default; stale/duplicate consumed at most once; cancellation never starts an automatic retry

inventory.decisionVocabulary: audience / visibility decision for a recovery decision record
inventory.reducer/conflictRule: recovery visibility reducer; deterministic same-precedence order
inventory.automaticDecisionPoint: recovery-visibility (recovery decision projection; closes with Wave 4 recovery authority)
inventory.observableEvidence: existing recovery-policy tests; Wave 4 recovery-consumption tests
inventory.failureAndCancellation: callback failure contained; official default; projection stays read-only

inventory.decisionVocabulary: channel authorization allow | deny for a possession-gated action
inventory.reducer/conflictRule: official verifier/authorizer combination; latest generation replaces previous; dispose is identity-bound
inventory.failureAndCancellation: callback failure contained; typed remote denial; identity-bound dispose

inventory.reducer/conflictRule: restriction filter composition; deterministic preflight order
inventory.defaultDecision: no restriction filter blocks the tool
inventory.failureAndCancellation: callback failure contained; official preflight default; abort propagated

inventory.decisionVocabulary: tool guard allow | deny for a guarded call
inventory.failureAndCancellation: callback failure contained; official preflight default; abort propagated

inventory.reducer/conflictRule: minimal-update policy semantics; latest generation replaces previous; dispose is identity-bound
inventory.failureAndCancellation: callback failure contained; typed outcomes; identity-bound dispose

inventory.reducer/conflictRule: ordered composition reducer; redaction boundaries preserved
inventory.automaticDecisionPoint: prompt-provenance (context composition before its projection is published)
inventory.failureAndCancellation: callback failure contained; official composition default; generation-bound dispose

inventory.componentOwner: official approval / tool before-after / model request owners
inventory.decisionVocabulary: domain policy decision at each declared security point
inventory.reducer/conflictRule: security policy composition; deterministic same-precedence order per point
inventory.defaultDecision: official fail-safe default per declared point
inventory.automaticDecisionPoint: security-policy (approval gate; tool before/after; model request)
inventory.failureAndCancellation: callback failure contained; fail-safe default; generation-bound dispose

inventory.decisionVocabulary: redaction rule for a protected payload
inventory.failureAndCancellation: callback failure contained; official default redaction; secrets never reach audit

inventory.componentOwner: multiple official outbound owners (llm provider, mcp, web, subprocess, connection, telemetry)
inventory.decisionVocabulary: egress allow | deny for a normalized outbound target
inventory.reducer/conflictRule: egress precedence with default deny; deterministic same-precedence order; exact-target binding
inventory.automaticDecisionPoint: egress/admit per matrix path (last stable pre-side-effect point; automatic authority in Wave 3)
inventory.protectedAction: official outbound side effect (connection, request, transport, child process)
inventory.observableEvidence: existing security-policy-egress tests; Wave 3 egress-enforcement tests
inventory.failureAndCancellation: fail-closed on contract absence or callback failure; redirect/reconnect/retry re-evaluates; AbortSignal preserved

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: adapter registration/decoration boundary before provider transport starts
enforcementMatrix.reentry: provider endpoint change or lazy resolution re-admits; new transport requires fresh admission
enforcementMatrix.verification: not implemented in this window: provider final endpoint is private inside the adapter closure; a provider-row replacement needs harness-verified parity

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: model-discovery callback wrapper before discovery transport starts
enforcementMatrix.reentry: each discovery transport is a new admission
enforcementMatrix.verification: packages/llm/test/apply.test.mjs: egress gate attached; discoverModels gates request.baseURL

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: MCP stdio initial connection and each reconnect before transport creation
enforcementMatrix.reentry: reconnect re-admits with the executable/command descriptor
enforcementMatrix.verification: packages/mcp/test/connection.test.mjs: egress gate deny blocks connect; allow proceeds

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: MCP HTTP connect/send after URL resolution, before request transmission
enforcementMatrix.reentry: reconnect and transport-switch re-admit with the resolved URL
enforcementMatrix.verification: packages/mcp/test/connection.test.mjs: egress gate deny blocks connect; allow proceeds

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: web provider boundary immediately before fetch/search
enforcementMatrix.reentry: provider endpoint change re-admits; provider-specific replacement when the final endpoint stays private
enforcementMatrix.verification: not implemented in this window: no approved dsh-web replacement; provider closure does not expose a facade-owned pre-fetch seam

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: attachment remote ingestion (inherited only when it provably uses the gated web service)
enforcementMatrix.reentry: direct bypass path does not inherit coverage
enforcementMatrix.verification: not implemented in this window: inherits web coverage only after the gated web service is proven; no direct gate added

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: official subprocess service lowest common point before spawn
enforcementMatrix.reentry: each child-process creation is a new admission
enforcementMatrix.verification: not implemented in this window: dsh-subprocess is a full official Service; a replacement needs harness-verified parity

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: official subprocess service before spawnTerminal
enforcementMatrix.reentry: each terminal spawn is a new admission
enforcementMatrix.verification: not implemented in this window: terminal rows route through the official subprocess component

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: official subprocess service before shell child-process creation
enforcementMatrix.reentry: each shell child process is a new admission
enforcementMatrix.verification: not implemented in this window: shell rows route through the official subprocess component

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: official browser transport real fetch/WebSocket attempt
enforcementMatrix.reentry: reconnect and transport switch re-admit; client receives a host coverage snapshot
enforcementMatrix.verification: not implemented in this window: browser transport is host/client split without a harness-verified gate

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: optional exporter send before export
enforcementMatrix.reentry: each export is a new admission; a provider that cannot be reached without contract breakage is a named optional edge path
enforcementMatrix.verification: not implemented in this window: official exporter row without an approved replacement

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: facade replacement remote/attachment outbound paths (transitive from final side-effect owner)
enforcementMatrix.reentry: an independent outbound side effect at a layer requires its own gate
enforcementMatrix.verification: not implemented in this window: coverage is proven transitively from the final side-effect owner

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: agent/request-error boundary before the next attempt or terminal error commit
enforcementMatrix.reentry: official retry provider normalizes into the same decision window; no second retry

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: tool dispatch/preparation failure before terminal step commit
enforcementMatrix.reentry: started calls keep operation identity; skipped/aborted keep official ordering

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: task settlement before terminal commit, retry or rollback
enforcementMatrix.reentry: same decision window as other recovery owners; no hidden mutation

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: workspace transaction recovery before terminal commit/rollback
enforcementMatrix.reentry: prepare/record/commit/rollback outer shape unchanged; recovery is not a generic rollback disposer

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: request preparation before adapter stream begins
enforcementMatrix.componentOwner: official llm request owner and adapter preparation
enforcementMatrix.reentry: re-entered request evaluates the effective transforms exactly once

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: RPC admission gateway before request dispatch
enforcementMatrix.reentry: each request admission is evaluated once

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: route decision owner before route commit
enforcementMatrix.reentry: each route selection is evaluated once

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: health transition owner on status change
enforcementMatrix.componentOwner: official llm routing health transition owner
enforcementMatrix.reentry: stale generation cannot flip a newer state

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: execution projection before audience publication
enforcementMatrix.reentry: projection stays read-only

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: recovery decision projection before publication
enforcementMatrix.reentry: closes with the Wave 4 recovery authority

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: verifier/authorizer gate before possession-gated action
enforcementMatrix.reentry: typed remote denial on failure

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: official tools pre-execute preparation
enforcementMatrix.reentry: deterministic preflight order

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: official tools pre-execute preparation
enforcementMatrix.reentry: deterministic preflight order

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: activation/catalog assembly before activation commit
enforcementMatrix.reentry: typed outcomes

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: context composition before its projection is published
enforcementMatrix.reentry: ordered composition; redaction boundaries preserved

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: approval gate; tool before/after; model request
enforcementMatrix.reentry: each declared point evaluated independently

enforcementMatrix.decisionPoint: visibility/redaction before serialization/publication
enforcementMatrix.reentry: host redaction precedes client serialization
